moods.feel: Warm pads and soft piano under a narrator; the explainer default.
Upbeat lo-fi groove; friendly, for tutorials.
Bright pop energy; promos and sizzles.
Slow strings and swells; launches and milestones.

voices.use: The house narrator for every product video.

rules: Agents suggest videos; a human-run studio makes them. Never write that an agent made, edited or rendered a video.
Every video wears its subject's brand. The style follows the product, it is not chosen.
Agents appear on screen only in Inside AmbientOS, never in product walkthroughs.
Every claim needs a source: product facts, a public page, or /pulse/.
AmbientScore runs on Claude. Never say Gemini runs the audit.

crew.name: Editor and director
crew.mandate: Owns the story: what stays, what's cut, the edit plan and the decisions log. The project manager.

crew.name: Writer
crew.mandate: Writes the voiceover for the ear: plain, warm, true to the sources, timed to the brief.

crew.name: Transcriber
crew.mandate: Turns the recorded voice into word-level timestamps: one clock for every clip, motion and caption.

crew.name: Animator
crew.mandate: Builds titles, callouts, transitions and motion in HyperFrames, on the words of the VO.

crew.name: Researcher
crew.mandate: Checks every on-screen and spoken claim against trusted sources. Flags, never invents.

crew.name: Screen editor
crew.mandate: Reframes real captures, zooms to the right control, guides attention, redacts what isn't the product.

crew.name: Sound designer
crew.mandate: Shapes the voice track, the music bed and the loudness mix. Music sits under the voice, never on it.

crew.name: Finisher
crew.mandate: The QC gate: format, loudness, black frames, flashes, gaps, captions. Nothing ships unchecked.
